description: This source file (main.swift) serves as the entry point for a command-line tool called 'swabble'. It orchestrates command parsing, dispatching subcommands, and executing associated asynchronously defined command handlers. The file primarily contains functions for dispatching varying subcommands related to 'swabble' and its modules like 'mic' and 'service'. It also manages the program's control flow, error handling, and final process exit.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes the CLI, resolves the command invocation, and handles errors, returning an integer status code.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the main command based on the first argument, routing 'swabble' commands to specific handler functions.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Dispatches subcommands under 'swabble', such as 'mic', 'service', etc., and calls respective handler functions.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping 'swabble' subcommands to their respective handler functions.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Helper function to extract a subcommand at a specific path index, throwing an error if missing.
